claims: Tom Izzo is the head men’s basketball coach at Michigan State University.
Tom Izzo has been the head men’s basketball coach at Michigan State University since 1995.
Tom Izzo is a Naismith Basketball Hall of Famer.
Tom Izzo has led the Spartans to numerous Final Four appearances.
Tom Izzo has led the Spartans to a national championship.
Tom Izzo is the winningest coach in the program's history.
